Matthew Parker at Q BarHyatt Regency San Antonio River Walk Learn MoreSee All EventsAdd Event17AprFri, Apr 17 @ 5:00 pmDry Comal Creek VineyardDry Comal Creek Winery & Vineyards Learn MoreSee All EventsAdd Event17AprFri, Apr 17 @ 6:00 pmTexas State San Marcos Bobcats Softball vs. Southern Miss Golden Eagles SoftballBobcat Softball Stadium Learn MoreSee All EventsAdd Event Local NewsNationwide recall for eye drops sold at multiple San Antonio stores, including H-E-B The Food and Drug Administration designated the action a Class II recall.Samuel Rocha IV, Newsroom TraineePublished: April 3, 2026 at 4:45 PMH-E-B (KSAT 12 News)66SAN ANTONIO – More than 3 million eye drop containers sold nationwide, including some at San Antonio-area H-E-B stores, have been recalled by the Food and Drug Administration (FDA).The FDA designated the action as a “Class II recall” on March 31, which is defined as “temporary or medically reversible adverse health consequences or where the probability of serious adverse health consequences is remote,” according to their website.Recommended VideosRecommended Videos1/20San Antonio couple stops swerving car, helps save unconscious driver on Loop 410 112.1K 23 Video Player is loading.Play VideoUnmuteDuration 2:09/Current Time 0:00Advanced SettingsLoaded: 24.63%0:00 Remaining Time -2:09 FullscreenPlayRewind 10 SecondsUp NextNextStayThis is a modal window.ShareSettingsPlayback SpeedNormalVideo QualityAuto (480p)Closed CaptionsOffReplay the list TOP ARTICLES Powered by AnyClipPrivacy PolicyKeyboard Shortcuts San Antonio couple stops swerving car, helps save unconscious driver on Loop 410 The cause for the nationwide product recall, according to the FDA, is due to “lack of assurance of sterility.”K.C. Pharmaceuticals, Inc, a California-based company, sold the eye drop solution under numerous names to stores nationwide such as H-E-B, Walgreens, Walmart and CVS. The recalled H-E-B-branded products include:H-E-B A.C. Eye DropsH-E-B Lubricant Eye DropsH‑E‑B Original Eye DropsThe full list of product names, expiration dates and specific stores can be found on the FDA report.More recent news coverage on KSAT: Hidden in plain sight: These quiet protectors hold back floodwaters in San AntonioBexar County ME’s Office identifies man killed in suspected East Side drive-by shootingCommunity members fill downtown San Antonio streets for Passion Play on Good FridayCopyright 2026 by KSAT - All rights reserved.About the AuthorSamuel Rocha IVSamuel Rocha joined KSAT as a Newsroom Trainee in the spring of 2026.
